description: Defines utilities and classes for Linux socket operations in the QUIC protocol implementation, including message headers, packet sending, and socket configuration.

classes.name: QuicMsgHdr
classes.description: Builds msghdr objects for sending packets via sendmsg, managing control messages and socket addresses.

classes.name: BufferedWrite
classes.description: Holds information for a single packet to be sent, including buffer, addresses, options, and release time.

classes.name: QuicMMsgHdr
classes.description: Builds mmsghdr objects for sending multiple packets at once via sendmmsg.

classes.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility functions for Linux socket operations, such as getting UDP segment size, enabling release time, setting IP info, and writing packets.

methods.name: SetIpInNextCmsg
methods.description: Sets IP info in the next control message.

methods.name: GetNextCmsgData
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to data in the next control message.

methods.name: GetTtlFromMsghdr
methods.description: Extracts TTL value from msghdr if present.

methods.name: SetIpInfoInCmsgData
methods.description: Sets IP address info in cmsg data.

methods.name: SetIpInfoInCmsg
methods.description: Fills in cmsg with IP address info.

methods.name: WriteMultiplePackets
methods.description: Sends multiple packets using sendmmsg if supported.
